Name: [Project] Restock maths must call the Stock.* DAX UDF
Description: inventory-restock: a Restock measure that does safety-stock / order-quantity maths (SQRT, ROUNDUP, NORM.S) must go through Stock.SafetyStock / Stock.ReorderPoint / Stock.OrderQty so the formula lives in one place.
Expression: DisplayFolder == "Restock" and RegEx.IsMatch(Expression, "(?i)SQRT|ROUNDUP|NORM\\.S") and not Expression.Contains("Stock.")
